items.Sentence: The construction of the expanded WWTF was completed in November 2009. The expanded WWTF includes a headworks, two oxidation ditches, one anoxic basin, four secondary clarifiers, three return sludge holding tanks, and three centrifuges.

Currently, one older centrifuge unit is in use, along with two new centrifuge units that were installed as part of the WWTF expansion.
Undisinfected secondary effluent is discharged to six percolation ponds (Ponds 1 through 5, and 7) with a surface area of approximately 36 acres.
Historically sludge handling practices included discharging sludge to unlined sludge drying beds; a practice that was conducted for over twenty years and has impacted shallow groundwater.
Sludge generated at the WWTF will continue to be hauled off-site and discharged to McCarthy Family Farms Inc., near Corcoran, California, for composting under appropriate WDRs.
